Summary: Jason held his gun with deadly precision. He stared down at the kid in the black mask. Summary: A mansion with an English butler traditionally has two layers: the plush lives of the owners above-stairs, and the hidden bustle of the staff below. Wayne Manor has a secret third thing. Bruce wants to build a Batcave. Alfred cannot be incinerating the candle at both ends. He needs staff. entry.title: Shut Up, Dead Man
entry.summary:
Author: plaguefairy

Rating: ExplicitLanguage: EnglishWords: 11,602Chapters: 4/4Kudos: 115

Summary: Bruce Wayne has been kidnapped. Now, the aftermath. . . . He awoke in the middle of the street. He had already been walking for some time, his knees told him as they ached, though he wasn't sure where. Home, he supposed. He stumbled over his own feet every other step. He figured his grappling hook got lost somewhere along the way, as well as the remote which summoned the car. Another Bruce Wayne might have chided himself for not even attempting to triangulate himself before calling for help, but this Bruce knew that he was on the verge of collapsing into an alleyway for someone else to find him, and the idea of risking his pride was much more appealing than risking his life. So he pushed down on his comm, mercifully still attached to his wrist. He noted with a wince the pain that came with lifting his arm, stemming from the crook of his elbow. "Holy sh—B?" Sounded from the other end. "Rrrobinn," he slurred, his left knee suddenly failing him as he fell against a brick wall with a grunt, "come 'n get me."

Cut off from the rest of the world, a fierce wave of Gothamite nationalism begins to rise from the rubble. Stripped of his high-tech arsenal, with the Batcave drowned in mud and the Batfamily stranded outside the borders, Bruce Wayne chooses to step forward and lead the city with an open face.
